title: converge-lint-runners-into-stage-aware-profiles-and-add-compact-dep-rotator-release-hook
author: Sophie Kim
description: Motivation: Our repo has grown multiple slightly-different lint/test workflows and several duplicate release hook steps that increase CI latency and make release automation brittle. This PR collapses language-specific lint runners into a stage-aware profile system (single entrypoint, plugin adapters for JS/Python/Go), and introduces a compact dependency rotator (dep-rotator) as a lightweight composite action + Go shim to perform safe devdep refreshes and emit a lockfile stamp used by staged release hooks. Goals: reduce presubmit runtime, centralize lint config, make release hooks safer and faster, and shrink CI dependency surface. What changed: consolidated .github/actions/lint-runner into a single stage-aware runner with plugin adapters; replaced three release-workflow hook copies with an annotated preflight-release step that uses the new dep-rotator artifact to gate asset builds; added a small Go tool (tools/dep-rotator) to compute minimal update bundles and write a dep-stamp artifact; introduced migration helper ci/migrate-release-hooks.sh to switch teams off legacy hooks; updated docs/ci/README.md with staged-release guidance and a short rollback playbook. Testing: local unit tests for dep-rotator, integration smoke on a staged repo, end-to-end dry-run in sandbox release pipeline. Rollout: feature-flag enabled on main for 48h, followed by org-wide switch. Backwards compatibility: legacy release hooks are preserved under .github/workflows/release-legacy.yml and will be removed after 2 weeks. Risks & mitigations: dep-rotator may surface transient updates; we added a dry-run mode and require two approvers for dep-bump PRs produced by the tool. Related: ENG-2245, ENG-3101. Checklist: ensure CI flakiness monitoring is on, coordinate with platform teams to opt teams into stage-aware lint profiles, monitor presubmit latency and release asset build times. This description is a single continuous string and summarizes context, changes, and rollout notes.
commits: feat(ci): introduce stage-aware lint runner with plugin adapter interface
refactor(ci): centralize lint config and reduce per-language workflow duplication
feat(dep-rotator): add Go shim to compute minimal devdep updates and emit dep-stamp
chore(ci): add ci/migrate-release-hooks.sh and docs for staged-release rollout
test(ci): add unit tests for dep-rotator and integration smoke for staged-release
ci: update workflows to use compact preflight-release hook and legacy fallback
